overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Board was scheduled to meet on September 14, 2026, to address several matters including a Wisconsin Pollutant Discharge Elimination System memorandum of agreement, a zoning change request for property on Lea Road, and the appointment of an interim clerk. The meeting was set to convene at 6:00 PM at the Kronenwetter Municipal Center.

agenda.item: Call Meeting to Order - Pledge of Allegiance and Roll Call
Public Comment (15 minutes total, 3 minutes per person)
Approval of August 24, 2026 Village Board Meeting Minutes
Resolution 2026-012, Wisconsin Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (WPDES) Memorandum of Agreement
Zoning Change Request - William Cywinski, 1900 Lea Road, 26.7 acres from AR to RR5
Appointment of Interim Clerk and Wage Setting
Consideration of Items for Future Agenda

discussions.item: Resolution 2026-012, Wisconsin Pollutant Discharge Elimination System (WPDES) Memorandum of Agreement
discussions.body: The board was scheduled to discuss and consider action on a WPDES Memorandum of Agreement. The nature and specific provisions of this agreement were not detailed in the agenda document, though such agreements typically address stormwater discharge or water quality matters.

The board was set to consider a zoning change request from William Cywinski for 26.7 acres located at 1904 Lea Road, proposing a change from AR (Agriculture and Residential) to RR5 (Rural Residential 5) zoning. The property is identified by parcel number 145-2707-124-0977.

discussions.item: Appointment of Interim Clerk and Wage Setting
discussions.body: The board was scheduled to address the appointment of an interim clerk position and establish an interim wage for this role. No details regarding the circumstances prompting this interim appointment were provided on the agenda.

publicComment: Public comment was on the agenda, limited to 15 minutes total with 3 minutes per person at the chief presiding officer's discretion.
actionItems: Scheduled to vote on Resolution 2026-012 regarding the WPDES Memorandum of Agreement
Expected to take action on the zoning change request for 1904 Lea Road
Scheduled to appoint an interim clerk and establish an interim wage
title: Village Board Meeting - 2026-09-14
